EXTENDED_ALL_AVAILABLE.purpose: non-gating inventory of older, future, partial or otherwise available data
EXTENDED_ALL_AVAILABLE.membership: all observations outside P0_2020_2025 or explicitly marked partial

fixture.null_policy: identity fields are blocking; optional descriptive fields remain explicit nulls
fixture.duplicate_policy: one canonical record per fixture; conflicting duplicates block closure

team_fixture.null_policy: missing team identity blocks the team-fixture
team_fixture.duplicate_policy: home and away are unique by fixture_id plus team_id
team_fixture.expected_denominator: two teams for each applicable fixture

lineup.grain: one team lineup in one fixture
lineup.null_policy: explicitly acknowledged empty response closes scope but does not prove content
lineup.expected_denominator: two lineups for fixtures whose coverage.lineups flag is true

lineup_player.grain: one named player role in one team lineup
lineup_player.null_policy: missing player identity or role is invalid; missing optional shirt data stays null
lineup_player.duplicate_policy: exact role duplicates collapse; conflicting roles block closure
lineup_player.expected_denominator: eligible fixture-team lineup slots, with starter content reported separately

formation.grain: one team formation in one fixture
formation.null_policy: blank formation is missing content, never an empty-valid formation
formation.duplicate_policy: one normalized formation per fixture-team; conflicts block closure

team_match_statistic.grain: one metric for one team in one fixture
team_match_statistic.null_policy: missing metric stays null; metric count is not the primary denominator
team_match_statistic.duplicate_policy: normalize aliases before uniqueness; conflicting values are invalid
team_match_statistic.expected_denominator: two team buckets for each eligible finished fixture

player_match_statistic.null_policy: publish fixture coverage separately from materialized player-fixture rows
player_match_statistic.duplicate_policy: merge compatible statistic buckets; conflicting identity blocks closure
player_match_statistic.expected_denominator: eligible fixtures, with player-fixture rows reported separately

player_season_profile.null_policy: pagination must be complete; a valid empty page is recorded separately
player_season_profile.duplicate_policy: deduplicate player identity across pages; conflicts block closure
player_season_profile.expected_denominator: pages_expected from paging.total and complete pagination receipts

event.null_policy: acknowledged empty event response is EMPTY_VALID at scope level
event.duplicate_policy: exact duplicates collapse; conflicting event identities block closure
event.expected_denominator: eligible fixtures, including explicit empty-valid responses

absence.null_policy: unclassifiable reason remains explicit and cannot be counted as injury or suspension
absence.duplicate_policy: page position is excluded; exact duplicates collapse and conflicts block closure
absence.expected_denominator: complete injuries pagination with empty-valid pages acknowledged

standing.grain: one team in one competition-season standing
standing.null_policy: final-season aggregate cannot impersonate point-in-time standings
standing.duplicate_policy: one row per team; conflicting group assignments block closure
standing.expected_denominator: distinct fixture-registry teams in the competition-season

round.null_policy: blank or unknown round stays missing
round.duplicate_policy: normalized round label is unique in competition-season
round.expected_denominator: distinct normalized rounds in the authoritative fixture census

referee_fixture.grain: one referee assignment in one fixture
referee_fixture.null_policy: missing referee is missing content on applicable terminal fixtures
referee_fixture.expected_denominator: one referee for each applicable terminal fixture

venue_fixture.grain: one venue assignment in one fixture
venue_fixture.null_policy: missing venue is missing content on applicable non-cancelled fixtures
venue_fixture.expected_denominator: one venue for each applicable non-cancelled fixture
